The COM team is responsible for building and managing the US Bureau capabilities. The team has knowledge and understanding of US Markets and the core products delivered to the Market.

This QA position is responsible for independently conducting test processes for testing projects. In addition, this position ensures that the documentation of test results is complete and accurate. We look for people who have a passion for quality and can collaborate within a team to delight our customers with our technology solutions.

title: Manual QA Tester
description:
The Manual QA Tester is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of software applications through comprehensive manual testing. The role designs and executes test scenarios, identifies and documents defects, validates fixes, and supports regression and release testing. The position works closely with Product, Development, Business Analysis, and Delivery teams to prevent defects, improve test coverage, and support timely, high\-quality releases.


  
* Plan, design, and execute manual test cases based on business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Perform functional, integration, system, regression, smoke, sanity, exploratory, and user acceptance testing as required.
* Identify, reproduce, document, prioritize, and track software defects using the approved defect management process and tools.
* Validate defect fixes and perform regression testing to ensure that changes do not introduce new issues.
* Work closely with Developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve testing issues.
* Review requirements and user stories early in the development lifecycle and identify gaps, ambiguities, risks, and testability concerns.
* Maintain test scenarios, test cases, test data, and test execution results with appropriate traceability to requirements.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support release validation and provide clear testing status, defect summaries, risks, and quality recommendations to stakeholders.
* Perform database validation and basic data verification using SQL when required.
* Ensure testing activities follow established QA standards, processes, documentation practices, and project timelines.

  
**Education/ Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* 1 to 3 years of hands\-on experience in manual software testing, preferably in web\-based or enterprise applications.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum software development environment.
* Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail, or equivalent tools preferred.
Experience with API testing tools such as Postman is preferred.  
* 

  

**Skills and Ability:**

* Strong understanding of software testing principles, QA processes, defect lifecycle, and industry\-standard testing methodologies.
* Hands\-on experience in creating comprehensive test scenarios, test cases, test data, and test execution reports.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a systematic approach to identifying, analyzing, reproducing, and troubleshooting software defects.
* Ability to understand business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria and translate them into effective and comprehensive test coverage.
* Experience in testing web\-based applications, including cross\-browser compatibility, responsive UI, functional, integration, and regression testing.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira or equivalent tools.
* Exposure to test automation concepts or hands\-on experience with automation testing frameworks and tools will be an added advantage.
* Working knowledge of Jira or similar defect/project tracking tools.
Experience with API testing, Postman, SQL/database validation, or automation testing concepts is a plus.  
* 

**Work Conditions/ Physical Demands:**  

  

This position is performed primarily in an office work environment and requires prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer. The role requires regular use of a keyboard, mouse, monitor, phone, and other standard office equipment. The employee must be able to communicate effectively through video conferencing, phone, email and other electronic communication tools. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


**Travel:** No regular travel is expected.

They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. Liquidity Services Inc. reserves the right to modify position duties at any time due to business necessity.*

description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands.**

**For more information, visit** **WPP.com.**

  


**Why we're hiring:**



Detection Engineering is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high\-fidelity detection logic across enterprise security platforms. This role focuses on proactive threat detection, automation\-first practices, and continuous improvement of detection coverage and accuracy, supporting the WPP SOC transformation into an Autonomic Security Operations model.


**What you'll be doing:**


* Develop, test, and maintain detection rules and logic across SIEM, EDR, NDR, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Regularly review and enhance detection logic to improve accuracy, reduce noise, and align with evolving threats.
* Work with wider WPP engineering teams to ensure high\-quality, normalized telemetry for effective detection.
* Automate detection rule deployment, QA, and version control using scripting and CI/CD pipelines.


**Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**


* Conduct RCA on missed detections, delayed responses, and high\-severity incidents.
* Identify technical and process\-level causes of detection failures or inefficiencies.
* Drive corrective actions based on RCA outcomes (e.g., rule improvements, visibility gaps).
* Continuous Security Improvement (CSI)
* Maintain a CSI backlog (detection gaps, telemetry blind spots, false positives to reduce).
* Analyze detection performance metrics to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
* Align detection priorities with business risk and the SOC transformation roadmap.
* Cross\-Team Collaboration
* Collaborate with SOC, Incident Response, and Threat Hunting teams to operationalize detection improvements.
* Work with Threat Intelligence teams to integrate emerging TTPs into detection logic.
* Contribute to purple team exercises by validating detection logic against simulated attack paths.


**Strategic Alignment to GCAT SOC10x**


* 10X People: Continuous learning and knowledge sharing within the team.
* 10X Process: Embed agile workflows and automation\-first principles.
* 10X Technology: Leverage AI/ML for detection tuning and anomaly detectio.
* 10X Visibility: Ensure comprehensive telemetry ingestion and observability.
* 10X Speed: Reduce detection\-to\-response cycle through orchestration and automation.


**What you'll need:**


**Technical Expertise**


* Strong knowledge of SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud security platforms.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation (Python, PowerShell).
* Familiarity with detection\-as\-code principles and CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of MITRE ATT\&CK framework and threat\-informed defense.


**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Ability to work closely with SOC analysts, threat hunters, and engineers.
* Skilled in documenting detection logic and RCA outcomes.


**Certifications (Preferred)**


* GIAC GCTI, GCFA, or equivalent advanced security certifications.


**Key Attributes**


* Automation\-first mindset with focus on scalability and resilience.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork capabilities.

**You're open*****:***we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open\-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.


**You're optimistic*****:*** we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.


**You're extraordinary:** We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

title: Software Testing Engineer
description:
